data.body:
[P1] Preserve SDK activity in independent retirement audits

This check still ignores original `sdkRequests` and attempt completion times. A failed case can retain a dispatch at 19,000 ms while its retirement snapshot omits that dispatch and declares the invocation settled at 15,000 ms, with observation end 20,000 and retirement at 21,000. Both this helper and the independent validator accept that snapshot, releasing the target despite contradictory activity. Preserve SDK request and invocation-completion facts, and require each settlement to cover the corresponding original request's last activity. Add a regression covering an omitted SDK dispatch.
